bubbles.speaker: narrator
bubbles.text: Canes Crescenza, 3091 AD. Spomenik Operative Bob sips his morning coffee, when suddenly the vessel's transmitter erupts...

bubbles.speaker: smokehouse
bubbles.text: Smokehouse Shift for Bob, this is Smokehouse Shift for Bob. You are cleared to initiate your Pulsar Protocol.

bubbles.speaker: bob
bubbles.text: W-what the hell Smokehouse? I've been out here for like, 3 kalpas metascanning intergalactic tumbleweed. Are you winding...

bubbles.speaker: smokehouse
bubbles.text: This is not a drill, Bob. Engage the Spomenik Transfer Protocol. Just like you were trained to do.
